source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban heritage" OR heritagization OR heritagisation OR ("heritage conservation" AND city)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban heritage" OR heritagization OR heritagisation OR ("heritage conservation" AND city),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban heritage" OR "heritagisation" OR "heritagization" OR ("heritage conservation" AND "city"))
